remarks: Welcome to your dream home-spacious, sun-filled, and move-in ready! This charming townhome boasts an updated kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances, seamlessly flowing into an open dining area and living room adorned with hardwood & laminate flooring. Enjoy easy access to your private deck from the living room, perfect for outdoor relaxation. The second floor features two generously-sized bedrooms with excellent closet space, alongside the full bath. The finished lower level adds versatility with a large storage room and bonus space ideal for a playroom, home office, or recreation room. Recent improvements include fresh paint. You'll love the convenient location-walk to the train, restaurants or enjoy quick access to highways and downtown Stamford. **Parking is designated in spot 3 or in one of the visitor spaces. Don't miss out! Complex is investor friendly.
